scope: Public SQL validation phase, condition/state/parameters and rows; not SDP Scala suite acceptance

cases.name: table_concat
cases.query: SELECT * FROM IDENTIFIER(concat('in', 'put'))

cases.name: table_cast
cases.query: SELECT * FROM IDENTIFIER(CAST('input' AS STRING))

cases.name: table_null
cases.query: SELECT * FROM IDENTIFIER(NULL)

cases.name: table_typed_null
cases.query: SELECT * FROM IDENTIFIER(CAST(NULL AS STRING))
cases.error: [NOT_A_CONSTANT_STRING.NULL] IDENTIFIER expression must not be NULL

cases.name: table_integer

cases.name: table_integer_division

cases.name: table_string_division
cases.query: SELECT * FROM IDENTIFIER(CAST(1 DIV 0 AS STRING))
cases.error: Division by zero

cases.name: table_random
cases.query: SELECT * FROM IDENTIFIER(rand())
cases.error: [NOT_A_CONSTANT_STRING.NOT_CONSTANT] expression is not foldable
